name: openspec-apply-change
title_zh: OpenSpec 变更单拆成可执行任务清单
tagline_zh: 拿到变更单别愣着——它帮你拆成一步步可勾选的任务，从开始到收尾都有节奏，不会卡在「下一步干嘛」的空白里。
tagline_en: Got an OpenSpec change? It breaks it into checkable steps, keeps momentum from kickoff to finish—no more 'what.
desc_en: Implement tasks from an OpenSpec change. Use when the user wants to start implementing, continue implementation, or work through tasks.
why_zh: 它不替你写代码，但把模糊的变更意图切成明确动作，让实现过程有进度感，也方便你随时回来续上。
why_en: It won't code for you, but slices vague intents into concrete moves—giving progress feel and easy resumption anytime.
limit_zh: 只认 OpenSpec 格式的变更目录；任务拆解止于清单，不生成具体代码改动；若变更描述本身含糊。
limit_en: Only reads OpenSpec-format change dirs; stops at task lists, no code edits; vague specs yield vague tasks.
title_en: Turn OpenSpec change into actionable task list
